knowledge_gaps: Branch allocation remains unresolved: measured snapshots show fixed 64/64 branches, while metric definitions describe Bernoulli(0.75) allocation. Verify the actual control implementation and checkpoint provenance before treating the treatment as a cutoff-only change.

The reported category checkpoint scores average to 0.5975, whereas previous inspirations report 0.5825. Identify which configurations, checkpoints and evaluation records produced each value; neither establishes a treatment gain.

Terminal diagnostics need a fixed, common training-prefix evaluation distribution and identical negative candidates across arms. Evaluating each model on its own sampling distribution would confound model quality with example difficulty.

The n>12 prevalence alone understates intervention strength differences. For history length n>12, the unconditional cutoff distributions have total variation distance 0.45*(1-10/(n-2)). Report this exposure measure by category using complete training histories; the supplied histograms are truncated.

The report omits an explicit uncertainty analysis and configuration-selection policy. With 200 validation users per category, one changed hit moves macro HR@10 by 0.00125. Any available paired-hit intervals must remain conditional on fitted models and fixed candidates and acknowledge adaptive checkpoint selection.

The sampler is an integration component rather than a reproducible training submission. Baseline integration, checkpoint/predictor compatibility and diagnostic-loader construction still require verification. Originality 3 and difficulty 3 are reasonable for the sampler alone; future potential 7 remains speculative without measured intervention exposure or treatment results.
